open_points.subject: check_token
open_points.text: check_token: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST compare the presented credential with the service token whole and case-sensitively in constant time, so the time taken does not depend on where they differ, return None when they are equal, and raise AuthenticationRequired otherwise; a matching token authorizes the one principal of the service, the calling flow of the owner, for every confirmed connection, and it MUST NOT log or return either value.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: Either AuthenticationRequired must be added to IMPORTS (or declared as a module-local exception), or the note must require raising the available DelivererError with an applicable RefusalCode member.
